name: Deymasollian
description: The Deymasollians were a sentient species native to the Colonies' Deymasoll system. They had two arms with delicate fingers and two legs—both limb pairs being relatively short—and a large mouth and prominent lower jaw. The Deymasollians had tan skin, dark eyes, and a coat of white fur. All Deymasollians had keen memory, and members of the species' society identified as belonging to at least one—female—gender.
